settings.text:
The Sun Resilience System combines UV Shield+ and Dermaboost+ in one dermatologist-formulated daily routine.

UV Shield+ provides targeted nutritional and antioxidant support for skin exposed to environmental and UV-related stress. Dermaboost+ adds broader antioxidant, nutritional, and normal immune support through vitamins, minerals, carotenoids, and botanical polyphenols.

Together, they create a two-step routine for people who spend significant time outdoors and want broader internal support beyond a single environmental-support formula.

settings.heading: Environmental support meets broader skin resilience.
settings.body:
The Sun Resilience System combines two formulas with related but distinct roles.

The combination is intentionally more overlapping than Sun Safe: UV Shield+ and Dermaboost+ share more of their biological pathways, particularly oxidative-stress biology.
settings.center: Protect against the demands of outdoor life. Support the systems skin relies on to stay resilient.

settings.text: Focused on nutritional and antioxidant support for skin exposed to outdoor and environmental stress.

settings.name: Dermaboost+

settings.heading: Why pair UV Shield+ with Dermaboost+?
settings.body:
Both formulas provide antioxidant-related support, but they approach the problem differently.

UV Shield+ is more specifically oriented toward environmental and UV-associated stress.

Dermaboost+ provides broader nutritional, antioxidant, and normal immune support.

The pairing is complementary in three main areas:

settings.note: This section describes formulation rationale. The combined Sun Resilience System has not been established here as a clinically tested finished-product regimen.

settings.title: Cellular signaling
settings.text: Different botanical polyphenols contribute distinct but overlapping mechanisms.

settings.title: Broader nutritional support
settings.text: Dermaboost+ adds vitamin C, vitamin D3, zinc, astaxanthin, and other nutrients that are not present in UV Shield+.

settings.heading: UV Shield+
settings.subhead: Daily support for active, sun-ready skin
settings.body:
UV Shield+ combines five ingredients selected for complementary nutritional and antioxidant roles:

  • Niacinamide
  • Polypodium leucotomos
  • EGCG
  • Trans-resveratrol
  • Spirulina

Its formulation is designed around broader coverage of environmental and oxidative-stress biology rather than reliance on one ingredient alone.

Key support areas: environmental stress, antioxidant support, outdoor lifestyle support, skin resilience.

settings.heading: Dermaboost+
settings.subhead: Daily immune support for calm, balanced skin
settings.body:
Dermaboost+ combines eight vitamins, minerals, carotenoids, and botanical ingredients selected for broader nutritional, antioxidant, and normal immune-supportive roles:

  • Niacinamide
  • Vitamin D3
  • Vitamin C
  • Zinc
  • Quercetin
  • Curcumin
  • Olive leaf extract
  • Astaxanthin

The formulation rationale identifies several complementary pairings within Dermaboost+, including quercetin + curcumin, quercetin + vitamin C, quercetin + astaxanthin, curcumin + olive leaf, and vitamin C + zinc.

Key support areas: antioxidant support, normal immune function, nutritional skin support, daily skin resilience.

settings.heading: Outdoor life creates more than one type of stress.
settings.body:
Environmental exposure can contribute to oxidative stress in skin. The body responds through multiple antioxidant systems, which is why the Sun Resilience System uses chemically different ingredients rather than relying on one antioxidant.

Across both formulas, the system includes:

  • Niacinamide
  • Polypodium leucotomos
  • EGCG
  • Resveratrol
  • Spirulina
  • Vitamin C
  • Quercetin
  • Curcumin
  • Olive leaf polyphenols
  • Astaxanthin
  • Zinc
settings.quote: Antioxidant support does not mean blocking UV radiation or replacing sunscreen.

settings.heading: Not all antioxidants work the same way.
settings.body:
A polyphenol is not the same as a vitamin. A carotenoid is not the same as a mineral. Different compounds have different chemical structures, cellular locations, and biological roles. That is the formulation rationale behind Sun Resilience.

UV Shield+ leans heavily on botanical polyphenols and environmental-stress support.

Dermaboost+ adds vitamins, minerals, carotenoids, and broader botanical support.

settings.heading: Skin is an immune-active organ.
settings.body:
Skin participates in the body’s interaction with the external environment. Normal immune function therefore matters to broader skin health.

Dermaboost+ contributes nutrients such as:

  • Vitamin D3
  • Vitamin C
  • Zinc

which have established roles in normal immune physiology.
settings.quote: Supporting normal immune function is not the same as treating immune-mediated disease.

settings.heading: Resilience is the goal, not perfection.
settings.body:
Skin is constantly:

  • Renewing
  • Responding
  • Adapting
  • Maintaining barrier function
  • Interacting with the environment

The Sun Resilience System is built around supporting those everyday processes from two directions: environmental support with UV Shield+ and broader nutritional support with Dermaboost+.

settings.heading: Is Sun Resilience right for you?
Built around intentional formulation.
settings.body:
Alchemia MD was created to make internal skin support more understandable and more deliberate.

Rather than asking customers to combine disconnected supplements on their own, each formula has a defined role, and each system brings those roles together only when the combination makes sense.

Sun Resilience pairs: Protect + Restore.

settings.question: What is the Sun Resilience System?
settings.answer: The Sun Resilience System combines UV Shield+ and Dermaboost+ in a two-product routine designed to provide environmental, antioxidant, nutritional, and normal immune support.

settings.question: Why are these two products paired?
settings.answer: UV Shield+ is focused more specifically on environmental and UV-related stress, while Dermaboost+ provides broader antioxidant, nutritional, and normal immune-supportive pathways. Their ingredient networks overlap in some areas while remaining distinct.

settings.question: Is Sun Resilience the same as Sun Safe?
settings.answer: No. Sun Safe is UV Shield+ + Skinbiotic+; Sun Resilience is UV Shield+ + Dermaboost+. Sun Safe adds gut-skin support. Sun Resilience adds broader nutritional and antioxidant support.

settings.question: Does Sun Resilience replace sunscreen?
settings.answer: No. The system should always be used alongside normal sunscreen and sun-safety practices.

settings.question: How do I take the system?
settings.answer: Follow each product label. UV Shield+: Take two (2) capsules once daily with water. For enhanced support, take two (2) capsules twice daily with water. Dermaboost+: Take two (2) capsules once daily with water. For enhanced support, take two (2) capsules twice daily with water.

settings.question: Can I buy the products separately?
Can I subscribe?
settings.answer: Yes. The plan options in the purchase box show all currently configured subscription and one-time purchase options.

settings.question: Is Complete Skin Defense better?
settings.answer: It contains all three Alchemia MD formulas and therefore provides broader coverage, but it is not necessarily the right option for every customer.
